نعتاض (form VIII)
# نَعْتَاضُ (naʕtāḍu) /naʕ.taː.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# نُعْتَاضُ (nuʕtāḍu) /nuʕ.taː.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# نَعْتَاضَ (naʕtāḍa) /naʕ.taː.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# نُعْتَاضَ (nuʕtāḍa) /nuʕ.taː.dˤa/: first-person plural non-p
